prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Fairy E. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: Sunset. The train stops at the foot of the Song Tree, a giant old tree standing alone on a round green hill in the middle of Sound Land; its huge branches are quiet and bare, with four small round empty hollows glowing faintly in its trunk. Animal friends from the whole journey gather on the hill around it, among them the twin bluebirds Pim and Pam (two tiny sky-blue birds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft). Bun and Hedgie look up at the tree; Grumble sets down his drum; Fairy E lands on Pip's head; Pip stands in front of the trunk, taking a deep breath. The moon is rising and one star twinkles. Hidden in the picture: the tree, the moon, the star, the train. No letters anywhere.
